annotation.bound_parties_text: Executive agencies (and contracting officers) are prohibited from procuring or operating FASC-prohibited unmanned aircraft systems, and must follow the documentation and assessment procedures.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: executive agencies are prohibited from— (a) Procuring a FASC-prohibited unmanned aircraft system
